body:
**What changed**
- **An update keeps your mod names:** a name you gave a mod with **Edit**, or typed in the install review, now stays when you install an update by hand, like its tags. A name the app made from the file name still follows the new download, and **Keep both** gives the second mod the download's name. Thanks to qhq (#20).

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.7.1.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
